_comment: Single dock-area layout for the PSF Determination tool. Settings render as compact foldable panels; the bead stack uses AutoForm's reusable 3D `image` section (z-slider + click-to-pick + bead markers + fit-ROI circle); the x/y/z profiles are declarative `plot` sections. All panels are draggable docks.

sections.label: Pixel (nm)
sections.description: Lateral camera/scanner pixel size in nm; scales σx/σy to physical FWHM.

sections.label: Z step (nm)
sections.description: Axial distance between z-slices in nm; scales σz to physical FWHM.

sections.label: ROI xy (px)
sections.description: Lateral ROI size (pixels) cut around a bead for the 3D Gaussian fit.

sections.label: ROI z (sl)
sections.description: Axial ROI size (slices) cut around a bead for the 3D Gaussian fit.

sections.label: Px/frame
sections.description: Expected bright pixels per frame; sets the adaptive quantile threshold for bead detection.

sections.label: Min dist (px)
sections.description: Minimum lateral distance between accepted beads (pixels); rejects clustered candidates.

sections.title: Stack
sections.description: Bead stack: use the z-slider to browse slices, click a bead to select+fit it. Green squares mark detected beads on the current slice; the yellow circle is the fitted lateral FWHM.

sections.title: x-profile
sections.description: Intensity along x through the fitted bead centre (data) with the Gaussian fit overlay.

sections.title: y-profile
sections.description: Intensity along y through the fitted bead centre (data) with the Gaussian fit overlay.

sections.title: z-profile
sections.description: Intensity along z through the fitted bead centre (data) with the Gaussian fit overlay.
Latest single-bead fit report or batch summary.
